conventions.annualization: arithmetic: mean per-period return x periods; volatility x sqrt(periods)
conventions.dsr: PSR against the expected maximum Sharpe of dsr_trials zero-skill trials, null variance 1/(T-1)
conventions.episodes: a run of bars a symbol is held with one sign; trade costs go to the episode they open or close (a flip splits them by size); financing is not allocated
conventions.returns: P&L over the fixed starting capital (no compounding)
conventions.sharpe: mean excess return over the sample std of excess returns, x sqrt(periods)
conventions.sharpe_se: iid: sqrt((1 + SR^2/2)/T); mertens: with sample skew and kurtosis; no autocorrelation correction
conventions.sortino: mean excess return over sqrt(mean(min(excess, 0)^2)), all periods

schedule.note: Rate verified ('current rate of $30.70'); its start date is not stated in the advisories: 2006-10-01 (start of FY2007) is a placeholder that only covers bars before 2007-03-17.
